rows.corpus_definition: A strong disagreement or argument between people.

rows.corpus_definition: a lack of politeness or kindness toward someone
rows.example_en: It is rude to show disrespect to your elders.

rows.corpus_definition: Not happy with the way things are.
rows.example_en: The customer was dissatisfied with the service.

rows.corpus_definition: To become mixed into a liquid until it disappears completely.
rows.example_en: Stir the sugar until it begins to dissolve.

rows.corpus_definition: To give items to several different people.
rows.example_en: The teacher handed out papers to every student.

rows.corpus_definition: A part of a city or country with its own name.
rows.example_en: He lives in the business district downtown.

rows.corpus_definition: The feeling that someone is not honest or cannot be relied upon.
rows.example_en: She felt a strong distrust of the stranger's motives.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of separating something into parts.
rows.example_en: The division of the work was fair.

rows.corpus_definition: A specific amount of medicine to take.

rows.corpus_definition: A soft mixture of flour and water used for baking.
